verdict.rationale: The evidence shows YYLO Skills ships existing SKILL.md files and a validation script, but it never documents an authoring template or the required name/description frontmatter for new skills. A developer would still have to reverse-engineer existing skills, and the validator is only an adjacent control, not an authoring guide.

support.subject: As a developer, I can author a new skill from a documented template — a SKILL.md with name and description frontmatter — without reverse-engineering existing skills
